dataList.data: The Java Collections Framework provides a set of interfaces and classes for storing and manipulating groups of data as a single unit.
List is an ordered collection that allows duplicate elements. Common implementations include ArrayList and LinkedList.
Set is a collection that contains no duplicate elements. HashSet is a common implementation.
Map stores key-value pairs. HashMap is a widely used implementation.
Collections provide efficient data structures for various programming needs. Choose the appropriate collection based on your requirements for ordering, uniqueness, and performance.
